advice.headline: 6 splits would leave the room at 49.2 °C, well above the 24 °C target. The room needs about 19.
reasons: 132.3 kW of load: 26 kW through the walls, roof and glass, 49 kW from people, 45.1 kW through the air that leaks in.
It needs a sensible heat ratio of 0.57, and a 2.5 HP split delivers 0.65.
The 6 units placed deliver 24.1 kW of sensible cooling; the room needs about 75.9 kW to hold 24 °C.
19 units running together draw 41.8 kW, and starting them all draws 146.3 kW. Stagger the starts or specify inverter units.
The dance floor runs 9.5 K warmer than the room at 58.9 °C, because the crowd is the load and the cold air thins out before it gets there.
